key.name: emoji-picker
key.summary: Open or close the emoji and symbols picker
key.description: Emoji and symbols over the window being typed in; the one picked is typed where the text cursor is. An empty list turns the picker off.

key.name: skin-tone
key.description: The tone of the hands and people the picker shows: none (the yellow), light, medium-light, medium, medium-dark or dark.
